column1: # Skill catalog, read by install.sh and pick.ts for the picker and the presets.
# Columns: name <TAB> group <TAB> presets <TAB> one-line blurb
# The blurb here is for a person choosing what to install, and it has to fit
# one line of an 80-column terminal — keep it under about 40 characters. The
# `description` in each SKILL.md is a different thing: it's what the agent
# matches against to decide when to load the skill. Don't merge them.
# presets: comma-separated. `core` is what the picker recommends.
